exposure: N-terminal segment of pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) level
cohort: This study included 2,040 high-risk infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Low weight gain rate, increased blood transfusion, invasive mechanical ventilation, and NT-proBNP ≥ 25,000 ng/L were independently associated with an increased risk of ROP in preterm infants.
gest_age: Preterm infants (Specific gestational age not mentioned)
